settings.heading: THE ART OF LAYERING
settings.description: Every scent we create is designed to play beautifully with the others. Spray, layer, and mix them on your skin to find your own signature trail.
settings.feature_1_text: Create a signature scent that is entirely yours. Blend different notes together directly on your skin to match your mood.
settings.feature_2_text: Our fragrances flow together naturally. Each note melts into the next, creating a soft, warm aura that never feels overpowering.
settings.feature_3_text: Instead of competing, overlapping sprays enrich each other. They settle beautifully on the skin, unveiling a deeper, more intimate scent.
settings.feature_4_text: Watch the fragrance evolve from a bright, fresh morning breeze into a cozy, skin-like warmth that stays with you all day and night.
